title: CPF Module Schema: Monitor Action Group ReadME
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-monitoractiongroup'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.

app_id.description: (Required) A descriptive name (abbreviation) for the workload (application) as it is registered in Leanix. The identifier format in Leanix is 'APP-12345', for the purpose of naming resources only 5 number will be used.

arm_role_receivers.type: list(object({ name = string role_id = string use_common_alert_schema = optional(bool, false) }))
arm_role_receivers.description: (Optional) A list of ARM role receivers for the action group. list(object({ name = "(Required) The name of the ARM role receiver." role_id = "(Required) The ARM role ID to notify." use_common_alert_schema = "(Optional) Whether to use the common alert schema for ARM role notifications." }))

automation_runbook_receivers.type: list(object({ name = string automation_account_id = string runbook_name = string webhook_resource_id = string is_global_runbook = bool service_uri = string use_common_alert_schema = optional(bool, false) }))
automation_runbook_receivers.description: (Optional) A list of automation runbook receivers for the action group. list(object({ name = "(Required) The name of the automation runbook receiver." automation_account_id = "(Required) The resource ID of the automation account." runbook_name = "(Required) The name of the runbook to execute." webhook_resource_id = "(Required) The resource ID of the webhook." is_global_runbook = "(Required) Whether the runbook is a global runbook." service_uri = "(Required) The URI of the webhook service." use_common_alert_schema = "(Optional) Whether to use the common alert schema for automation runbook notifications." }))

azure_app_push_receivers.description: (Optional) A list of Azure app push receivers for the action group. list(object({ name = "(Required) The name of the Azure app push receiver." email_address = "(Required) The email address associated with the Azure mobile app account." }))

azure_function_receivers.type: list(object({ name = string function_app_id = string function_name = string function_key = string use_common_alert_schema = optional(bool, false) }))
azure_function_receivers.description: (Optional) A list of Azure Function receivers for the action group. list(object({ name = "(Required) The name of the Azure Function receiver." function_app_id = "(Required) The resource ID of the Azure Function App." function_name = "(Required) The name of the Azure Function to invoke." function_key = "(Required) The key for the Azure Function." use_common_alert_schema = "(Optional) Whether to use the common alert schema for Azure Function notifications." }))

context.description: (Optional) Application context information for the resource(s) (max 71 chars).

email_receivers.type: list(object({ name = string email_address = string use_common_alert_schema = optional(bool, false) }))
email_receivers.description: (Optional) A list of email receivers for the action group. list(object({ name = "(Required) The name of the email receiver." email_address = "(Required) The email address of the receiver." use_common_alert_schema = "(Optional) Whether to use the common alert schema for email notifications." }))

enabled.description: (Optional) Whether the action group is enabled. When disabled, no notifications will be sent.

environment.description: (Required) The environment where the resource is deployed. Given as abbreviation to leave more characters to the other naming components (max 3 chars).

event_hub_receivers.type: list(object({ name = string event_hub_name = optional(string, null) event_hub_namespace = optional(string, null) subscription_id = optional(string, null) tenant_id = optional(string, null) use_common_alert_schema = optional(bool, false) }))
event_hub_receivers.description: (Optional) A list of Event Hub receivers for the action group. list(object({ name = "(Required) The name of the Event Hub receiver." event_hub_namespace = "(Optional) The name of the Event Hub namespace." event_hub_name = "(Optional) The name of the Event Hub." subscription_id = "(Optional) The subscription ID where the Event Hub is located." tenant_id = "(Optional) The tenant ID for the Event Hub." use_common_alert_schema = "(Optional) Whether to use the common alert schema for Event Hub notifications." }))

instance.description: (Optional) Instance number, if context includes/requires multiple resources of the same type (max 3 int).

itsm_receivers.type: list(object({ name = string workspace_id = string connection_id = string ticket_configuration = string region = string }))
itsm_receivers.description: (Optional) A list of ITSM (IT Service Management) receivers for the action group. list(object({ name = "(Required) The name of the ITSM receiver." workspace_id = "(Required) The workspace ID of the ITSM connection." connection_id = "(Required) The connection ID of the ITSM connection." ticket_configuration = "(Required) The JSON string that defines the ticket configuration." region = "(Required) The region of the ITSM connection." }))

logic_app_receivers.type: list(object({ name = string resource_id = string callback_url = string use_common_alert_schema = optional(bool, false) }))
logic_app_receivers.description: (Optional) A list of logic app receivers for the action group. list(object({ name = "(Required) The name of the logic app receiver." resource_id = "(Required) The resource ID of the logic app." callback_url = "(Required) The callback URL of the logic app." use_common_alert_schema = "(Optional) Whether to use the common alert schema for logic app notifications." }))

resource_group_name.description: (Required) Name of the Resource Group in which to create the resource.

short_name.description: (Required) A short name for the action group. This will be used for SMS and other notifications that have character limits.

sms_receivers.type: list(object({ name = string country_code = string phone_number = string }))
sms_receivers.description: (Optional) A list of SMS receivers for the action group. list(object({ name = "(Required) The name of the SMS receiver." country_code = "(Required) The country code for the phone number (e.g., '1' for US, '44' for UK)." phone_number = "(Required) The phone number without the country code." }))

tags.description: (Optional) Tags to be set on each resource.

voice_receivers.type: list(object({ name = string country_code = string phone_number = string }))
voice_receivers.description: (Optional) A list of voice call receivers for the action group. list(object({ name = "(Required) The name of the voice receiver." country_code = "(Required) The country code for the phone number (e.g., '1' for US, '44' for UK)." phone_number = "(Required) The phone number without the country code." }))

webhook_receivers.type: list(object({ name = string service_uri = string use_common_alert_schema = optional(bool, false) aad_auth = optional(object({ object_id = string identifier_uri = optional(string, null) tenant_id = optional(string, null) }), null) }))
webhook_receivers.description: (Optional) A list of webhook receivers for the action group. list(object({ name = "(Required) The name of the webhook receiver." service_uri = "(Required) The URI where the webhook payload will be sent." use_common_alert_schema = "(Optional) Whether to use the common alert schema for webhook notifications." aad_auth = "(Optional) Azure AD authentication settings for the webhook receiver. Includes: object_id = "(Required) The Azure AD object ID of the service principal or managed identity to authenticate the webhook." identifier_uri = "(Optional) The Azure AD application identifier URI." tenant_id = "(Optional) The Azure AD tenant ID." ) }))

id.description: The ID of the created Monitor Action Group.

name.description: The name of the created Monitor Action Group.

resource.description: The name of the resource group where the Monitor Action Group is created.

short_name.description: The short name of the Monitor Action Group.

agent_instructions.summary: To provision 'Monitoractiongroup' via Terraform, call this CPF module with the inputs defined below. Required inputs have no default and must be provided.
